# froghop-double 799: measure the flags forward, repair the phase on the way back — 799 x 12,710,657 (-882,316 T, -6.5 %)

**Result (local: BitWonka's fasteval, an exact replica of `eval_circuit`, on the grader's own 9,024 shots — all OK,
0 classical / 0 phase / 0 ancilla; the official evaluation is the grader's):** 799 qubits x 12,710,657.155 average executed
Toffoli. Not a frontier score: a low-qubit Pareto point, a same-qubit **down move** on our own 799 row (`1dbb08bc`,
799 x 13,592,973), the lowest Toffoli at <= 799 qubits.

## The lever (exact; no new approximation)

froghop-double's forward traversals erased their flags by recomputing them, and its inverse traversals (each slot
recorded and played inverted) regenerate every such flag anyway. This build X-measures the flag in the forward traversal
(Hmr into a fresh receipt bit) and repairs the phase (-1)^(receipt x flag) in the inverse traversal right after the plain
erase, played inverted, has regenerated the flag. It is the ghost-receipt pattern of the froghop-one line
(jieyilong's measured turn flag with inverse phase repair; edi3on's 818 tree `SlotMode::ForwardGhost /
RecordInverseWithRepair`), ported to froghop-double's record-and-invert inverse.

| site | where (`froghop_double.rs`) | forward | inverse |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | S8 P3 discriminator ladder | the ladder is a pure erasure of the CO->RT marker mk = [code 111 & !dep0]: mk into a clean qubit, three CX (111 -> 000), Hmr; **no ladder** | the ladder as before + a receipt-conditioned CCX/CCZ/CCX phase repair (1.5 expected T) |
| 1 | S3 probe dl erase scan (pool >= 2) | Hmr dl | erase scan regenerates, Z-if repair |
| 2 | SC stack-scan gate gq | Hmr | gate recompute + Z-if |
| 3, 5, 6 | S4 turn tt, push gate upq, dv0 | Hmr | erase recompute + Z-if |
| 4 | S5 rt0 (odd slots) | Hmr | erase recompute + Z-if |
| 7 | S3 gate g | Hmr | erase recompute + Z-if |
| 8 | S3 probe dl uncompute (pool >= 2) | — | Hmr dl into a fresh bit r, then under r: the probe scan with CZ/CCZ in place of its CCX/MCX writes |

Site 0 dominates: the P3 ladder was 27 % of a pool-1 traversal and now runs in two of the four traversals only.

**Why it is exact.** At the forward measurement the flag qubit holds exactly f(state); the inverse traversal reaches the
same register state at the repair point (every inverse slot is the exact inverse of the plain slot, and the measured
forward slot leaves every qubit exactly as the plain slot does); the phase debt is diagonal in the traversal-register
basis and everything between measurement and repair has the form W^-1 (controlled-only product) W, so it commutes and
the repair cancels it. Site 0's identity mk == ct holds on every on-model shot; on a shot where the truncated P3's ct is
wrong the base already fails, and this build fails too.

## What changed

`froghop_double.rs` (the nine sites, guarded so `BW_GHOST=0` restores the plain traversal for A/B), `builder.rs`
(receipt bits), `tests_g1.rs`; on top of our 799 row's source (Cuccaro ladders at POOL_D = 8) with the exact post-pass suite. `POOL_D =
8`, `NONCE = 2`. Development switches (`BW_GHOST`, `BW_GHOST_MASK`, `BW_POOL_D`, `FH_NONCE`, `BW_POSTPASS`,
`BW_CUCCARO`, `BW_TTK`) are inert in an empty environment.

## Gates

- **Equivalence first:** with `BW_GHOST=0` the source rebuilds our 799 row's stream byte for byte.
- **Tests:** 19/19 pass at pool 8; per slot (1,240) on 64 random on-model shots with random dirty passenger lanes: the measured
  forward slot equals the plain slot on every qubit, and forward slot + inverse recording played inverted is the identity
  including phase; every receipt written once and read once. Negative controls (drop each repair, each Hmr, swap
  receipts, drop the site-8 phase oracle): every mutant caught.
- **Fixed-input A/B against our 799 row** (32 seeds x 9,024 identical inputs): the same 20 shots fail in both; none fails only on this build, and all are off-model by the integer model. The lever adds
  measurements, so measurement words are not aligned between the two streams; every shot in the comparison was classified
  with the integer model.
- **Nonce:** `NONCE = 2`; scan k = 0..7 failing 1 1 0 1 0 1 0 0; the first clean count; none chosen for its Toffoli count.
- **Reproducibility:** a clean-checkout compilation of the packaged source (NONCE 2) in an empty environment gives the
  same ops.bin as our worktree's NONCE 0 build plus the deterministic nonce tail (the post-passes split the tail off and
  re-append it), sha256 `7643d8133ee6f220322bc9e5a660e59393fa0ad9582f431749fe11ca2f955047`.
- Lambda: the base machine's (~0.6-0.8 failing shots per 9,024 on fixed inputs); under the PR 419 limit of 18.
- Evaluator: BitWonka's fasteval, re-validated on 24 Oct against `eval_circuit` at harness 6b0327d; our 13 froghop-double
  rows today matched the official grader to the digit.

## Reproduce

```sh
cargo run --release --bin build_circuit      # or ./benchmark.sh
BW_GHOST=0 cargo run --release --bin build_circuit   # our previous 799 row, for A/B
```

## PR 419 limiting contract

No error-for-score trade: the lever changes no window, precision or approximation; it moves erasures into measurements
with an exact phase repair.

Copied in full from PR 419, as carried by the base rows' notes.
